blocks.translation:
• Warning — Read before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and older. Do not give it to children under the stated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries. Keep it away from small children to prevent accidental swallowing, which can cause choking.
• This product contains electronic components; people with pacemakers should take care when using it.
• This product has pointed and sharp parts. Take care when handling and storing it to avoid unexpected injury.
• Do not use this product close to the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• Do not stare at flashing LED lights. Doing so may cause nausea or other illness.
• Incorrect battery use may cause overheating, explosion or leakage. Follow the precautions below.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with correct +/− polarity.
• Always turn the power off and remove the batteries after use. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, immediately flush with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If battery fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing, follow your local municipality's waste disposal instructions.
